items.title: Product & Technical Communications
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE You'll be responsible for: - Developing and articulating our long-term vision for the future of human-AI interaction, and what we’re building for developers and businesses. - Shaping the narrative around our products (in particular ElevenAgents), connecting our capabilities to emerging needs and trends in the wider world. - Leading storytelling and communications for top tier product launches, in partnership with product marketing, and running campaigns between launches to demonstrate the value our platform delivers. - Owning our security, privacy, and safety communications, including managing incident responses as part of a cross-functional team. - Producing superb written materials that advance our product story – including keynotes, talk tracks, social posts, and press releases – and creating scrappy product demos to show our technology in action. - Building the profile of our technical and product leadership, developing novel points of view, and supporting them with media, social, and event appearances. - Nurturing relationships with journalists, Substack writers, podcasters, technical creators, and other influencers who shape developer and enterprise buying decisions. REQUIREMENTS We are looking for someone who has: - Run product or technical comms at a fast-paced B2B technology company, or built AI / software products. - A record of leading significant launches, and running effective product campaigns in between them. - Exceptional writing across different formats, with a talent for turning complex, technical topics into sticky narratives. - Experience working with security, safety, and engineering teams, and managing incidents. - Deep understanding of the independent media landscape and good relationships with some of the most influential commentators. - A track record of excellence, be that building products, running superb campaigns, or some other entrepreneurial endeavor. LOCATION This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere on the US East Coast, with the ability to operate in GMT-5 to GMT-4 timezones required. If you prefer, you can work from our New York office. #LI-Remote We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Office & Facilities Manager
items.description: Our global HQ in Malta is looking for an Office & Facilities Manager who loves turning workplaces into places people genuinely enjoy coming to. If you’re proactive, detail-driven, and energised by creating great day-to-day experiences, this is your opportunity to shape how our offices in Malta look, feel, and run. The Wow As the Office & Facilities Manager , you’ll own the smooth running of our Malta workplace operations and help set the standard for how our spaces support people. From facilities excellence to a standout employee experience, you’ll make sure every detail enables productivity, wellbeing, and our Betsson brand. You’ll also bring our culture to life by delivering well-run internal events and office initiatives. Reporting to the Director of HR Support in Malta, you will implement workplace standards, manage budgets and supplier partnerships, and ensure our offices are safe, efficient, and welcoming. You’ll coordinate everything from day-to-day services to event logistics, so employees and visitors experience a seamless, on-brand workplace. What you’ll be involved in: Key responsibilities (including, but not limited to): Deliver engaging internal events and office initiatives (e.g., Friday Get-Togethers, on-site parties, and activities), covering logistics, run-of-show, supplier coordination, comms, budgets, and post-event learnings. Own office and facility operations, ensuring safety, functionality, and a consistently great look-and-feel aligned with Betsson’s brand. Maintain facility management processes and documentation that support ESG/ISO standards and focus on continuous improvement. Manage vendor and supplier relationships (facilities and event-related), ensuring strong service, clear SLAs, and cost-effective solutions. Support space planning and expansion projects, coordinating moves, changes, and office improvements to match business growth. Manage health, safety, and compliance protocols across the office, including risk assessments and safe working practices for on-site activities and events. Monitor and manage budgets for facilities and workplace experience spend, tracking costs and optimising for value without compromising quality. Lead and develop the reception team to deliver a warm, professional front-of-house experience for employees and visitors. What we are looking for: 5+ years of experience in facilities management, office operations, workplace experience, or a similar role within a global organisation. Hands-on experience planning and executing office events (from supplier sourcing and budgets to on-the-day coordination and wrap-up). Proven expertise managing multi-site operations, budget oversight, and vendor partnerships, with a pragmatic, service-minded approach. Knowledge of health, safety, and environmental regulations, plus solid technical facilities management understanding. Excellent project management and communication skills, with the ability to coordinate stakeholders across teams and locations (including event partners). Why join us? Be part of a vibrant, fast-paced industry at the heart of Malta’s online gaming scene. Join a collaborative, people-focused HR team that values ownership, smart solutions, and getting things done. Grow your career in an environment that encourages autonomy, continuous learning, and development. Much like a rollercoaster, life at Betsson Group is fast-paced, full of twists and turns, and always exciting. With more than 2,800 colleagues representing over 75 nationalities across a global network of offices – including 1,500 at our operational headquarters in Malta – every day brings new challenges and opportunities to grow. It may not be for the faint-hearted, but if you thrive on innovation, enjoy pushing boundaries and want to be part of a diverse, international team, then you’ll fit right in at Betsson. Challenge Accepted? By submitting your application, you understand that your personal data will be processed as set out in our Privacy Policy .

items.title: Accounting Lead, Hardware
items.description: ABOUT THE TEAM OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission to ensure that artificial general intelligence benefits all of humanity. The Controllership team delivers the financial truth that powers OpenAI’s growth. By translating operational activity into accurate, timely, and decision-grade financial data, we enable leadership to scale the business with confidence. Our commitment to rigorous controls and best-in-class systems ensures financial integrity as OpenAI grows. ABOUT THE ROLE We are seeking a strategic and execution-oriented Accounting Lead, Hardware to build and scale inventory accounting capabilities across consumer hardware and robotics businesses. This role partners closely with Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing Operations, Technical Accounting, Strategic Finance, and Systems teams to establish scalable inventory and supply chain accounting processes and reporting infrastructure supporting rapid growth and product launches. The ideal candidate brings strong accounting fundamentals, sound judgment, and a track record of building scalable processes in complex, evolving businesses. Inventory, cost accounting, or supply chain experience is preferred, and accounting experience supporting hardware, infrastructure, data centers, or other capital-intensive operations is also valuable. We welcome strong accounting professionals from other backgrounds who have demonstrated the ability to quickly learn unfamiliar business models and accounting topics and take ownership of new areas. This person should thrive in ambiguity, combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, and communicate effectively with cross-functional partners and senior leadership. This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees. IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL: INVENTORY ACCOUNTING - Lead inventory and supply chain accounting across consumer hardware and robotics programs, including inventory valuation, supply chain/sourcing arrangements, manufacturing variances, reserves, and close processes. - Partner with Supply Chain, Operations, and Strategic Finance to support BOM accuracy, labor and overhead assumptions, operationalize supply chain strategies and gross margin analysis. - Develop scalable accounting processes for NPI, prototyping, engineering builds, and mass production. - Own inventory-related accounting policies and controls, including capitalization, overhead allocation, LCNRV/NRV assessments, rebates, freight, tariffs, and inventory controls. ERP SYSTEMS & PROCESS DESIGN - Serve as a finance lead for Oracle Fusion manufacturing costing and inventory implementations, enhancements, and process optimization. - Partner with Systems, IT, and Operations to design scalable finance processes, controls, reporting structures, and operational workflows. - Partner with Systems and Operations to define accounting requirements and guide ERP design for product costing, inventory transactions, and related reporting and controls. FINANCIAL CLOSE, REPORTING & CONTROLS - Lead monthly, quarterly, and annual cost accounting close activities and improve scalable reconciliations, reporting, and management review processes. - Partner with Strategic Finance on margin reporting, inventory analytics, and budget versus actual analysis. - Establish SOX-ready controls, support audits and technical accounting matters, and drive continuous improvement across close and reporting processes. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP - Act as a strategic partner to Operations, Supply Chain, Procurement, and Program Management teams. - Translate ambiguous business needs into scalable accounting and operational frameworks. - Influence senior stakeholders through strong communication, executive presence, and data-driven recommendations. - Help build and scale the long-term roadmap for hardware controllership, manufacturing accounting, and operational finance infrastructure. YOU MIGHT THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU: - Bring strong accounting judgment and enjoy learning how physical products, infrastructure, and operational workflows translate into financial reporting. - Have a track record of quickly developing expertise in unfamiliar accounting areas, asking thoughtful questions, and turning what you learn into practical processes and controls. - Can comfortably operate between strategic leadership discussions and highly detailed operational accounting analyses. - Have strong executive presence and can communicate effectively with senior leadership and cross-functional partners. - Enjoy building scalable processes and infrastructure in fast-moving, ambiguous environments. - Are highly detail-oriented and maintain a strong control mindset while balancing business partnership. - Have a strong systems orientation and enjoy designing scalable ERP and reporting processes. - Are intellectually curious, proactive, and solutions-oriented. QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. - 8+ years of progressive accounting experience, with ownership of complex accounting areas, close processes, or operational accounting. - Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP and demonstrated ability to research unfamiliar accounting topics and apply sound judgment. - Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new business models, systems, and operational processes and take ownership of unfamiliar accounting areas. - Experience building or improving accounting processes, reconciliations, controls, and reporting. - Strong systems aptitude and experience working with ERP systems and financial data. - Excellent analytical, communication, and cross-functional partnership skills. - Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and execute effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable; candidates are not expected to bring all of them: - Inventory, cost, manufacturing, or supply chain accounting, including inventory valuation, standard costing, manufacturing variances, overhead allocation, rebates and buy/sell etc. - Accounting supporting hardware, infrastructure, data centers, electronics, robotics, semiconductors, or other capital-intensive operations. - Work with contract manufacturers, global supply chains, hardware product launches, or manufacturing scale-up. - Oracle Fusion, particularly Costing and Inventory modules, or comparable ERP implementation and process improvement experience. - CPA and/or public accounting background. - Experience in a high-growth technology environment or building and leading accounting teams. WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS This role will play a foundational part in building the accounting infrastructure that supports the next generation of AI hardware products. You will help shape the systems, policies, controls, and operational processes that enable scalable manufacturing operations, reliable financial reporting, and launch readiness as the business rapidly grows. You’ll have the opportunity to work cross-functionally with world-class teams at the forefront of AI, robotics, and consumer hardware innovation while helping build a best-in-class hardware controllership organization from the ground up. About OpenAI OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. For additional information, please see OpenAI’s Affirmative Action and Equal Employment Opportunity Policy Statement https://cdn.openai.com/policies/eeo-policy-statement.pdf. items.title: Data Center Strategic Sourcing Lead - Construction
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role We are hiring a Strategic Sourcing lead to drive development and execution of procurement strategies to help scale Anthropic's Data Center electrical and mechanical Owner Furnished Equipment (OFE) footprint. In this role, you will own end-to-end sourcing strategies for critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure such as generators, switchgear, UPS systems, chillers, and cooling equipment. You will partner closely with engineering, demand planning, construction, and third parties to drive equipment availability, establish vendor relationships, and negotiate commercial agreements. As a sourcing lead focused on key Data Center equipment, you will play a critical role in helping Anthropic to achieve its ambitious scaling goals. Key responsibilities Drive commercial negotiations and Master Purchase Agreements for critical electrical and mechanical infrastructure such as generators, medium- and low-voltage switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, chillers, cooling towers, CRAHs, and pumps. Audit partner procurement schedules, ensure optimal allocation, and drive cost efficiency of supply in constrained markets. Implement frameworks for ensuring third-party data center partners and general contractors adhere to commercial equipment terms and technical specifications. Develop global inventory strategy including warehousing, third-party logistics, buffer stock, and distribution models to accelerate time to market and improve availability. Proactively monitor global supply chain volatility (e.g., lead times for transformers, generators, and switchgear) and execute contingency plans to avoid critical project delays. Translate construction and capacity roadmaps into equipment forecasts and procurement pipelines. Partner with Finance to optimize inventory and capital deployment strategy. Establish efficient return, repair, and replacement workflows with OEMs to restore failed equipment quickly. Negotiate warranty, startup/commissioning support, and spare parts terms, and track vendor performance Minimum qualifications Have 7+ years experience in supply chain management, sourcing, and procurement. Have a track record of developing processes for forecasting, planning, and managing data center electrical and mechanical equipment for build-out and/or operations. Are familiar with data center electrical and mechanical equipment (e.g., generators, switchgear, transformers, UPS, batteries, chillers, cooling towers, CRAHs/CRACs, pumps, CDUs). Possess a bachelor's degree in a relevant domain (e.g., electrical/mechanical engineering, construction management, supply chain) or equivalent practical experience. Preferred qualifications 10+ years experience in supply chain management, sourcing, and procurement. 5+ years experience in data center or critical environment infrastructure. Experience working with general contractors, MEP integrators, OEMs, and equipment distributors. Experience working on data center construction programs. Familiarity with liquid cooling equipment (CDUs, dry coolers, manifolds) and battery energy storage systems. Leadership and influencing skills. Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $405,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.description: About the Team OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, our custom silicon program, the team works across silicon architecture, RTL design, verification, physical design, systems software, and infrastructure to deliver highly performant, efficient, and scalable hardware solutions. The Silicon & Systems team brings together hardware and software engineers to co-design and build the next generation of AI infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of silicon, systems, and software, tackling complex technical challenges across the full hardware development lifecycle, from early architecture and design through validation, deployment, and production. About the Role We’re looking for an Infrastructure Software Engineer to build and scale the infrastructure and developer workflows that power OpenAI’s custom silicon development. You’ll work closely with engineering teams across design verification, physical design, emulation, formal verification, and systems software to develop reliable, automated, and efficient workflows that accelerate hardware development. In this role, you'll own and improve the cloud infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC) environments, CI/CD pipelines, regression systems, and data platforms that support our silicon engineering teams. You'll translate complex hardware development requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions, reducing manual overhead, improving reliability, and enabling engineers to iterate faster. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role with opportunities to drive improvements across the entire hardware development lifecycle. We're looking for engineers who bring deep expertise in one or more infrastructure domains, strong software engineering fundamentals, and an interest in expanding their impact across the broader platform. In this role, you will: - Build developer tools and workflows: Partner with hardware engineering teams to understand their development processes, identify bottlenecks, and build tooling, services, and APIs that automate workflows and accelerate engineering productivity. - Develop and scale regression infrastructure: Design, implement, and operate large-scale regression systems spanning job scheduling, execution, results collection, triage, and reporting, with a focus on performance, reliability, and reproducibility. - Own CI/CD infrastructure: Build and maintain automated pipelines for infrastructure, developer tooling, and cluster configurations, enabling safe deployments, testing, and continuous improvement. - Scale cloud and HPC environments: Design, provision, and operate cloud infrastructure and high-performance compute clusters, optimizing scheduling, capacity, reliability, and cost efficiency to support demanding silicon development workloads. - Build data infrastructure and observability: Develop data pipelines, databases, and monitoring systems that provide visibility into regression results, infrastructure health, resource utilization, and engineering efficiency. - Drive platform reliability and operational excellence: Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, improve monitoring and alerting, automate recovery processes, and build systems that are resilient, maintainable, and scalable. - Collaborate across hardware and software teams: Work directly with engineers across RTL, verification, physical design, emulation, and software to continuously improve the infrastructure supporting OpenAI's silicon development. You might thrive in this role if you: - Have strong software engineering fundamentals, with proficiency in Python or a similar programming language and experience building reliable automation, tools, or infrastructure services. - Bring deep technical expertise in at least one area of infrastructure engineering, such as Linux/HPC environments, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD systems, storage, networking, or EDA development workflows. - Have experience designing, deploying, and operating cloud infrastructure, preferably Azure, with familiarity in infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform or Bicep. - Have strong Linux systems knowledge, including processes, filesystems, networking, permissions, performance troubleshooting, and system administration. - Have experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, Buildkite, GitHub Actions, or similar platforms. - Are comfortable debugging complex distributed infrastructure problems, identifying root causes, and implementing durable solutions. - Enjoy working closely with engineering teams to understand technical requirements and translate them into scalable, practical infrastructure solutions. - Take ownership of systems end to end, from initial design and implementation through deployment, monitoring, and ongoing operational improvements. - Bring strong technical judgment, clear communication, and a collaborative approach to solving ambiguous engineering challenges. - Are curious about hardware development and excited to expand your technical expertise across infrastructure, silicon design workflows, and developer productivity. items.title: Director of Corporate Development
items.location_text: Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY
items.description: Join us in building the future of finance. Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading. About the team + role We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world’s biggest financial problems. We’re looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn’t a place for complacency, it’s where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We’re a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards. Robinhood is looking for a Director of Corporate Development to help accelerate our roadmap by identifying, vetting, and executing acquisitions, strategic investments, and other transactions. In this role, you will develop a deep understanding of Robinhood's strategic priorities and market landscape, and partner with GMs and senior leadership to identify high-potential opportunities across our existing and future product verticals and geographies. You will help build Robinhood's network of founders, investors, and bankers, and develop relationships that may lead to acquisitions or strategic investments. You will work closely with deal sponsors and cross-functional leaders across Robinhood on all aspects of M&A, including business case construction, valuation analysis, deal structuring, negotiation, due diligence, execution, and post-close integration. You will present opportunities to company leadership and the Board of Directors, facilitate key decisions, and provide post-acquisition performance updates. The ideal candidate is strategic, relationship-oriented, analytical, and results-oriented, and thrives at a public company that still operates like a startup. This role is based in our Menlo Park, CA or New York, NY offices, with in-person attendance expected 3 days per week. At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams. What you’ll do Analyze Robinhood's strategic landscape, gather competitive and industry intelligence, and develop the business case and rationale for key M&A opportunities, advocating for them internally. Manage transactions end to end, including sourcing, valuation, negotiation, diligence, and closing, and partner with integration teams to deliver a seamless post-close transition. Lead deal evaluation meetings and drive decision-making with objectivity, diplomacy, and effectiveness. Cultivate relationships with founders, venture capital firms, and investment banks to build a proactive pipeline of future acquisitions and strategic investments. Collaborate with business sponsors and leaders across Legal, Finance, Compliance, Product, and Engineering to build clear business and financial cases and execute deals. Present opportunities and recommendations to senior leadership and the Board of Directors, and report on post-acquisition performance against the original deal thesis. Help build scalable processes, playbooks, and best practices that shape the operating system of Robinhood's Corporate Development team. What you bring 10+ years of experience in corporate development, investment banking, venture capital, private equity, or other investing roles, ideally within fintech, financial services, or consumer technology. Track record of sourcing, leading, and closing complex technology acquisitions or strategic investments, ideally including in-house corporate development experience. Exceptional analytical skills, including company valuation, financial modeling, and structured problem solving. Ability to reason from first principles, using data and analysis to draw sound conclusions, with a bias toward action: analyze fast, decide, and either move forward or move on. Strong interpersonal skills and a track record of building strong working relationships with founders, investors, bankers, and executives. Executive presence and outstanding written and verbal communication, including experience presenting to senior leadership and boards. Resourceful, persistent, and able to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment. Familiarity with Robinhood and our industry. You enjoy managing your money on your phone! What we offer Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career. Performance-driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, equity ownership, and 401(k) matching. Best-in-class benefits to fuel your work, including 100% paid health insurance for employees with 90% coverage for dependents. Lifestyle wallet — a highly flexible benefits spending account for wellness, learning, and more. Employer-paid life & disability insurance, fertility benefits, and mental health benefits. Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, parental leave, and more! Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. In addition to the base pay range listed below, this role is also eligible for bonus opportunities + equity + benefits. Base pay for the successful applicant will depend on a variety of job-related factors, which may include education, training, experience, location, business needs, or market demands. The expected base pay range for this role is based on the location where the work will be performed and is aligned to one of 3 compensation zones. For other locations not listed, compensation can be discussed with your recruiter during the interview process. Base Pay Range: Zone 1 (Menlo Park, CA; New York, NY; Bellevue, WA; Washington, DC) $242,000 — $285,000 USD Zone 2 (Denver, CO; Westlake, TX; Chicago, IL) $213,000 — $251,000 USD Zone 3 (Lake Mary, FL; Clearwater, FL; Gainesville, FL) $189,000 — $222,000 USD Click here to learn more about our Total Rewards, which vary by region and entity. If our mission energizes you and you’re ready to build the future of finance, we look forward to seeing your application. AI Usage Disclosure: Robinhood uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our recruiting process. These tools enhance the efficiency and consistency of our hiring process; however, all hiring decisions are made by our hiring teams. Robinhood provides equal opportunity for all applicants, offers reasonable accommodations upon request, and complies with applicable equal employment and privacy laws. Inclusion is built into how we hire and work—welcoming different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences so everyone can do their best. Please review the Privacy Policy for your country of application.

items.title: Identity & Access Management Lead
items.description: WE ARE BETCLIC 🎯 Betclic, European leader in sports betting, is much more than just an online gaming site! Also offering Poker, Horse Racing, and Casino games across various countries and continents, it is an inspiring and forward-thinking company: every day brings new challenges in a modern and dynamic environment. As an influential player in the tech industry, with strong and sustained growth over the years, we believe in innovation through diversity and inclusion and encourage everyone to reach their full potential. With our multicultural team, we provide an optimal, safe and responsible gaming experience, powered by cutting-edge technology. WHY JOIN US? 🚀 At Betclic, success comes from passionate and committed teams. Here’s why you’ll love working with us: 💡An international and creative environment where every project is an opportunity to innovate 📈Hypergrowth that brings new challenges and development opportunities every day 🏡A healthy work-life balance: flexible remote work and workplace well-being are essential pillars for us. 🌟A unique and friendly atmosphere, with 1,600 employees across 5 countries and our headquarters in Bordeaux Are you passionate about sports and tech? Join us and help shape the future of online gaming! ENTER THE GAME🎮 As a member of the SecOps team within Defensive Security, you will build and lead a cross-functional Identity and Access Management (IAM) capability from the ground up. You will define the vision, establish the foundations and coordinate the teams and processes needed to manage identities and access across multiple environments and tenants, including Active Directory, Entra ID and Okta. YOUR ROLE WITHIN BETCLIC🔥 In this role, your main missions will be to: Strategy, organization, governance · Assess the existing IAM landscape , including directories, applications, identity data, access models, provisioning workflows and integrations; identify technical gaps, risks and implementation dependencies. · Define the IAM strategy, governance framework, target architecture and roadmap , translating requirements into technical designs and implementation plans (covering configuration, integrations, data and entitlement mapping, migration, testing and deployment) · Partner with IT, business and security teams to define access requirements and controls for workforce, privileged and service accounts. · Establish identity lifecycle processes with HR and IT, covering joiners, movers, leavers and role changes; · Design and implement an Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) framework, including role and entitlement models, access reviews, ownership and segregation of duties. · Promote IAM best practices and clarify access management responsibilities across the organisation. Architecture and technical solutions · Lead the end-to-end implementation of IAM and IGA solution, workflows and controls , from design and integration through deployment and operational handover, including access requests, approvals, provisioning, access changes, reviews and deprovisioning. · Define the access control model, including RBAC and ABAC approaches, entitlement mapping, access bundles, and rules for exceptional or time-bound access. · Design and oversee lifecycle automation across applications and directories · Lead the integration and evolution of IAM solutions across environments such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and Okta. · Evaluate external IGA and IAM solutions. · Define multi-tenant standards and IAM governance, including operating processes, application and role ownership, and control monitoring. · Establish performance indicators and drive continuous improvement. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? 🔍 We are looking for passionate and curious professionals who bring kindness and a touch of enthusiasm! You have at least 5 years of experience in IAM or cybersecurity, including significant experience leading cross-functional projects or programmes. You have built or significantly improved an IAM or IGA capability in a complex, multi-entity or multi-tenant environment. You have experience with identity platforms and directories such as Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and/or Okta. You understand identity lifecycle management, access governance, role and entitlement models, access certification and segregation of duties. You have practical knowledge of identity integration and provisioning standards, including SCIM 2.0, SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect (OIDC) and OAuth 2.0. You understand authentication and access control concepts, including single sign-on (SSO), multi-factor authentication (MFA), privileged access management (PAM) and service or non-human identities. You can work effectively with HR, IT, business and security teams, translating business processes into secure and practical identity controls. You have strong analytical, organisational and communication skills, and can prioritise work across a broad stakeholder landscape. You are proactive, adaptable and comfortable building a new capability in an evolving technical and business context. You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. And finally, you speak English fluently WHAT ARE THE RECRUITMENT STEPS?📝 If your application is shortlisted, Maxime will contact you within a week for an initial HR screening (30 minutes). Then, you will complete the AssessFirst test (personality, motivation and cognitive reasoning). Next, you will have a technical interview with Jean-Luc, Senior Defensive Cybersecurity Manager, and a technical expert. You will then meet with Sophie, Global Security Director. Finally, Maxime will conduct a final HR interview to review your AssessFirst results together. The recruitment process usually takes between 4 to 6 weeks to ensure an optimal experience for you. WHAT CAN YOU EXPECT?🎁 ✅ 25 days of paid leave and 10 RTT days 🍽️ A Ticket Restaurant® card credited with €11 per day (€6 per day funded by Betclic) 🩺 100% health insurance coverage for you and your children 🚆 50% reimbursement of public transport costs or an annual sustainable mobility allowance (€230 for commuting with sustainable transport) 🏡 Hybrid work model 📚 Access to a vast training catalog, with opportunities for professional development every year 🏢 Extraordinary office spaces with a rooftop where you can enjoy sunny breaks with a view of the Cité du Vin 🎉 Internal events to liven up your daily life 🏋️ On-site sports classes and organized tournaments (Pilates, circuit training, boxing, yoga, futsal, padel, tennis…) Permanent contract, available immediately in Bordeaux (remote from another city possible depending on profile - on-site presence required twice a month)Betclic Group – 117 Quai de Bacalan, 33300 BORDEAUX

items.description: Part-Time | Project-Based 🚀 ABOUT OUR CLIENT Our client is developing a next-generation MarTech platform designed to help businesses unlock new revenue opportunities and scale through smarter technology. As part of its product expansion, the team is developing an advanced iGaming player data platform and looking for an experienced industry professional to help shape its strategy, architecture, and roadmap. 🎯 ABOUT THE ROLE This is an opportunity to put your iGaming CRM / CDP expertise into practice and directly influence the development of a new player data platform. Our client is looking for an experienced consultant who understands how leading iGaming operators manage player data, retention, segmentation, promotions, and multi-brand ecosystems. You'll help evaluate the market, identify the right technology solutions, and define what should be built in-house versus sourced from third-party providers. 💡 WHAT YOU'LL BE WORKING ON - Industry & Market Research: Analyze existing iGaming CRM, CDP, and PAM solutions, identify leading providers, compare capabilities, and share industry best practices. - Product Strategy: Help define the vision and priorities for a unified player data platform across multiple brands. - Build vs. Buy Assessment: Evaluate third-party solutions, their features, pricing, and suitability versus developing an in-house platform. - Roadmap Development: Define key functionalities, technical requirements, resources, priorities, and implementation timelines. - Expert Advisory: Challenge existing product ideas, review proposed solutions, and provide practical recommendations based on your hands-on experience. - Performance & Retention: Advise on player segmentation, real-time triggers, bonus effectiveness, and measuring incremental revenue. 🔍 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - Hands-on experience with iGaming CRM, Customer Data Platforms (CDP), or Player Account Management (PAM) systems. - Strong understanding of player lifecycle management, retention, player profiles, and segmentation. - Experience with multi-brand or cross-brand player data environments. - Background in designing or implementing player profiles, bonus targeting, promotional mechanics, game recommendations, or real-time triggers. - Understanding of player wallets, bonus engines, reward mechanics, and promotional rules. - Ability to assess CRM and bonus performance through data, experiments, and incremental revenue measurement. - Knowledge of bonus abuse prevention and responsible gambling principles. - Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn complex industry knowledge into clear recommendations and actionable roadmaps. - Excellent written and verbal English communication skills. ⭐ NICE TO HAVE - Experience working directly with iGaming operators. - Experience building or selecting in-house CRM / CDP solutions. - Familiarity with unified wallets, bonus engines, missions, tournaments, and reward systems. - Experience with white-label or multi-market platforms, particularly in Asia or Latin America. - Knowledge of analytics platforms such as Amplitude, Mixpanel, or PostHog. - Experience designing control-group experiments and measuring campaign effectiveness. What makes this opportunity interesting? You won't be stepping into another operational CRM role. Instead, you'll have the chance to share your expertise, influence product direction, and help shape a platform from the ground up — while maintaining flexibility over your workload.

items.title: Marketing Lead, Claude Frontier Academy
items.location_text: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY
items.description: About Anthropic Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. About the role Claude Frontier Academy is where organizations nominate their strongest people to build deep, hands-on skills with Claude. Backed by a $100 million commitment, Anthropic aims to train 10,000 Frontier Deployed Engineers by the end of 2027. The Academy’s first program, the Frontier Deployed Engineer (FDE) Residency, brings engineers from leading customers and partners together in cohorts, and more programs will follow. We’re looking for a Marketing Lead to make the Academy a name the market knows and a credential people are proud to earn. As the Academy’s first dedicated marketer, you’ll own how it shows up in the world. You’re a creative, versatile marketer who thinks in terms of brand and communications and also knows how to position, launch, and grow programs. You’ll turn each program launch into a major market moment, celebrate milestones like new cohorts and the first badges earned, and build a community of graduates who help tell the story. Because the Academy serves both partners and customers, this role will sit on our Partner Marketing team. You’ll work directly with partners and customers to secure their participation in announcements and bring them into our launch and amplification plans. You’ll help shape the Academy’s strategy and annual plan and represent marketing with senior leaders, while staying hands-on enough to write the first draft yourself. Partners and customers already engage with other Anthropic education and training programs, so you’ll be thoughtful about how the Academy fits alongside them. If you’ve built a branded program at a B2B technology company and want to do it again at a much bigger scale, this role is for you. Key responsibilities Own the marketing strategy and annual plan for Claude Frontier Academy and its programs, working with Academy leadership to set priorities and goals Build and maintain a calendar of market moments for the Academy and each program, including program launches, new cohorts, and badge milestones Lead launches end to end, from messaging and announcement drafts through legal and executive review, launch-day execution and post-launch amplification Partner with Communications on press releases and announcements, including sourcing customer and partner quotes and securing approval to use their names Align early with Partnerships, Communications, and Account Teams on which customers and partners are named in each announcement, who gets a heads-up before it goes live, and how to answer those who aren’t named Develop amplification plans with partners and customers across social posts, blogs, newsletters, and their own announcements, and turn cohort results into joint customer and partner stories Grow the Academy’s presence on LinkedIn and other social channels with content that showcases programs, cohorts, and graduates Own the Academy’s web presence and any paid promotion, working with our web team and with creative and agency partners Build a community program that keeps cohort members and badge holders connected and turns them into advocates for the Academy Work with Brand to extend the Academy’s naming and brand architecture as new programs launch, keeping it consistent with, and clearly distinct from, Anthropic’s other education and training offerings Learn Anthropic’s other education and training programs, such as Claude Academy, Claude certifications, and Partner Basecamp, and work with their teams to define where Claude Frontier Academy fits, where the programs connect, and how they reference each other, so partners and customers see one clear path Equip Account Teams and Partner Account Managers with FAQs, internal announcements, and guidance so they can answer questions, help customers and partners register their interest, and set clear expectations on participation Keep senior stakeholders aligned through regular status updates and clear recommendations, and define and report on success metrics for Academy marketing Minimum qualifications Have built and run branded B2B marketing programs at a software/SaaS technology company, such as customer education, certification, community, or user conference programs Have marketed education, training, or certification programs at a technology company, such as a partner, customer, or developer academy Bring a creative, brand-minded approach and know how to create market moments that get noticed Have led major launches or announcements, coordinating press, social, and partner amplification, and keeping everyone aligned through legal review, executive edits, and date changes Know how to build an audience and spark conversation on LinkedIn and other social channels with B2B audiences Have strong executive presence and are comfortable giving updates and making recommendations to senior leaders Can operate at both strategic and tactical levels, comfortable owning an annual plan and rolling up your sleeves to ship Build trusted relationships with partners, customers, and cross-functional teams, and can drive approvals and commitments without formal authority Are an excellent writer who can move easily between press releases, FAQs, and social posts Are energized by ambiguity and by building something new as a first-in-seat marketer Passionate about AI diffusion and bringing the benefits of AI to people and the world Preferred qualifications 8+ years of B2B software marketing experience spanning brand, communications, or program marketing Experience building community or advocacy programs where members promote the program themselves Experience marketing to technical audiences, particularly engineers and developers Experience running joint announcements with global system integrators, consulting firms, or enterprise customers Experience marketing to enterprise technology leaders, such as CIOs and CTOs Experience marketing AI/ML products Role-specific policy: For this role, we expect all staff to be able to work from our San Francisco office at least 2 days a week, though we encourage you to apply even if you might need some flexibility for an interim period of time for relocation. Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 — $320,000 USD Logistics Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act. We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. How we're different We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. Come work with us! Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

items.title: Solutions Engineer, Canada
items.description: About Glean: Glean is the Work AI platform that helps everyone work smarter with AI. What began as the industry’s most advanced enterprise search has evolved into a full-scale Work AI ecosystem, powering intelligent Search, an AI Assistant, and scalable AI agents on one secure, open platform. With over 100 enterprise SaaS connectors, flexible LLM choice, and robust APIs, Glean gives organizations the infrastructure to govern, scale, and customize AI across their entire business - without vendor lock-in or costly implementation cycles. At its core, Glean is redefining how enterprises find, use, and act on knowledge. Its Enterprise Graph and Personal Knowledge Graph map the relationships between people, content, and activity, delivering deeply personalized, context-aware responses for every employee. This foundation powers Glean’s agentic capabilities - AI agents that automate real work across teams by accessing the industry’s broadest range of data: enterprise and world, structured and unstructured, historical and real-time. The result: measurable business impact through faster onboarding, hours of productivity gained each week, and smarter, safer decisions at every level. Recognized by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies (Top 10, 2025), by CNBC’s Disruptor 50, Bloomberg’s AI Startups to Watch (2026), Forbes AI 50, and Gartner’s Tech Innovators in Agentic AI, Glean continues to accelerate its global impact. With customers across 50+ industries and 1,000+ employees in more than 25 countries, we’re helping the world’s largest organizations make every employee AI-fluent, and turning the superintelligent enterprise from concept into reality. If you’re excited to shape how the world works, you’ll help build systems used daily across Microsoft Teams, Zoom, ServiceNow, Zendesk, GitHub, and many more. You'll be deeply embedded where people get things done. You'll ship agentic capabilities on an open, extensible stack, with the craft and care required for enterprise trust, as we bring Work AI to every employee, in every company. About the Role: Glean is seeking a Solutions Engineer to help enterprise customers in Canada connect complex business and technical challenges to practical outcomes with Glean. You will partner with Account Executives across the sales cycle, leading discovery, tailored demonstrations, technical evaluations, security conversations, and business-value discussions. You will: Partner with Account Executives to navigate complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles, including executive stakeholders. Lead technical discovery with customers to understand business goals, workflows, technical requirements, stakeholders, and success criteria. Create and demonstrate tailored customer environments based on industry, line of business, and customer use cases. Plan and manage technical proofs of concept (POCs), aligning scope, success criteria, and next steps with customers. Lead customer-facing technical discussions, including security conversations, to address questions and build confidence in Glean’s security posture. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems. We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that. We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft. We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us! As a Senior Security Operations Engineer you will: - Serve as trusted advisor to team’s leadership and partner teams by clearly articulating business risks associated with security issues - Harden our cloud-native environments (AWS, OCI, GCP) by introducing secure by default cloud controls - Own and drive resolutions for enabling engineers to design, build, and use infrastructure securely at scale by paving the secure path using infrastructure-as-code modules and reusable code libraries - Manage IAM / RBAC for cloud infrastructure, and partner with IT on streamlining authentication/authorization to ensure unified access control across the board - Deploy, integrate and operationalize security platforms and services including but not limited to SIEM, SOAR, domain monitoring, endpoint tooling, cloud security tooling - Respond to security incidents and harden environments post-incidents. - Support control monitoring and remediation for compliance initiatives - Gather and analyze security metrics to address security issues with cross-team dependencies - Partner empathetically with engineering teams to understand their needs and deliver practical, scalable security solutions without creating unnecessary friction. You may be a good fit if: - 5+ years previous experience in SecOps, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Threat Detection & Response or software development with a strong focus on security engineering. - You’re a hands-on security engineer interested in automating controls and building scalable solutions rather than relying on manual processes. - You have experience in managing cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI) and Kubernetes environments - Familiarity with CI/CD systems and SecOps workflows (Git, Terraform) in cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI) - Have practical experience with one or more of : infrastructure automation, network segmentation, system hardening, container and cloud security concepts, and security observability - You have experience with multiple languages such as Golang and/or Python - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and adapting your approach as requirements evolve. - You employ a flexible and constructive approach when solving problems - You are able to make trade-offs between build vs. buy decisions - help build solutions and able to review what tools are available - You understand secure engineering best practices, can articulate problem statements and propose solutions to both technically savvy and non-technical audiences FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS: - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch. - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health. - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme. - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent. - Annual enrichment benefits: Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit. items.title: Head of Public Sector, AMER
items.description: ABOUT ELEVENLABS ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. HOW WE WORK - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. WHAT WE OFFER - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. - Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. ABOUT THE ROLE We're hiring a Head of Public Sector to build and lead ElevenLabs' government business in the US. Government agencies are moving voice and conversational AI from pilots into production for citizen services, contact centers, accessibility, training, and mission operations. You'll own how ElevenLabs shows up in that market, from strategy and pipeline through to the team that delivers the revenue. We don't use traditional job titles at ElevenLabs. This role is equivalent in scope and seniority to a Vice President of Public Sector, with ownership of the vertical, authority to hire and structure the team, and direct access to the executive team. You'll work closely with the executive team, Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security. You'll set the vision for how ElevenLabs serves the government, decide how the team is structured and staffed, and stay close to the largest pursuits. You'll lead from the frontline alongside your team while hiring the leaders who will take over portfolios as the business grows. IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL - Define and execute the go-to-market strategy across US Federal (Civilian, Defense, Intelligence), State, Local, and Education. - Own the public sector revenue plan, forecast, and pipeline, and report on them to the executive team. - Recruit and lead the team, including additional Account Executives, segment or regional leaders, capture and proposal support, and sales operations. You'll have the authority to shape the org. - Lead from the frontline with your team on the largest and most complex pursuits, from first agency conversation through procurement, security review, and award. - Shape our approach to contract vehicles and channels, including GSA Schedule, cooperative contracts, procurement vehicles, and partnerships with systems integrators and resellers. - Build and maintain relationships with senior agency leaders, procurement officials, technical stakeholders, and the integrator and partner ecosystem. - Work with Product, Engineering, and Security to define and prioritize what government customers require, including FedRAMP, StateRAMP, IL5, ITAR, data residency, FOCI Mitigation and sovereign or on-premise deployment. You'll bring customer and pipeline evidence to roadmap decisions. - Work with Legal and Finance on government contracting terms, pricing, and the processes public sector sales depends on. - Create repeatable sales processes, performance metrics, and operating rhythms so revenue becomes more predictable as the team grows. - Partner with the Forward Deployed Engineer and Account Manager orgs so early deployments become references and expand across agencies. - Work with Marketing on public sector messaging and content, and with government affairs and policy contacts to track regulation, funding, and procurement changes. - Serve as the public face of ElevenLabs in the government market, at agency briefings, and industry events. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 15+ years of progressive experience in technology sales or business leadership, with at least 10 years in public sector markets. - Experience leading government sales teams, with a record of hiring and developing both individual contributors and managers. - Proven track record of securing, large ARR strategic contracts with government agencies. - Prior experience building a public sector business unit or equivalent leadership role at a technology company, ideally at an early or growth stage. - Deep knowledge of federal, state, and education procurement, including funding mechanisms, acquisition vehicles such as GSA Schedule, GWACs, and IDIQs, and how buying decisions are made. - Working knowledge of compliance and security requirements such as FedRAMP, FISMA, CMMC, IL5, ITAR and FOCI mitigation strategies. - Experience selling cloud, AI, or other advanced technology to the government; familiarity with navigating AI trust and safety questions. - Executive credibility with senior government officials, program leaders, and technical and security reviewers. - An established network across agencies, systems integrators, and public sector partners. - Comfort staying hands-on in deals while building the team and the playbook. WHY THIS ROLE The opportunity is to define the strategy, hire the team, and shape what we build for government, with direct support from leadership and a company growing as fast as ElevenLabs. LOCATION While we operate as a remote-first company, there is a strong preference for this role to be based in Washington DC. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

items.title: Quant Risk Analyst - Derivatives & Clearing
items.description: ABOUT POLYMARKET Polymarket is the world's largest prediction market platform, where people trade on the outcomes of real-world events. As our markets, volumes, and derivative product suite grow, so does the sophistication of the risk infrastructure behind them. Our clearing and risk systems must operate with the rigor of a traditional clearinghouse while moving at the speed of a crypto-native trading platform. THE ROLE We're hiring a mid-level quantitative risk analyst to design and implement enterprise-scale risk models at the heart of our clearing operation. You'll own models for market risk, volatility and correlation of derivatives, stress testing, and automated liquidation — the systems that keep the platform solvent and users protected in fast-moving markets. This is a hands-on role: you'll be building models in production code, not just specifying them. We expect you to work fluently with AI tools for development and research — and to be the skeptic in the room, pressure-testing AI-generated models and code against well-established risk frameworks before anything ships. WHAT YOU'LL DO - Design, implement, and maintain enterprise-scale risk models covering market risk, margin, and counterparty exposure for a clearing organization. - Build volatility and correlation models for derivatives, including calibration, backtesting, and ongoing model validation. - Develop and run stress-testing frameworks: historical scenarios, hypothetical shocks, and reverse stress tests. - Design and tune auto-liquidation logic — trigger thresholds, liquidation waterfalls, and safeguards against cascading liquidations. - Use AI tools extensively to accelerate model development, coding, and research — and rigorously validate AI outputs against established risk models (VaR/ES, SPAN-style margining, GARCH-family volatility models, standard correlation frameworks) before deployment. - Monitor model performance in production, investigate breaks, and iterate quickly. - Partner with engineering, trading, and product teams to embed risk controls into platform architecture. - Document model assumptions, limitations, and validation results to an audit-ready standard. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR - 5–7 years of quantitative risk experience at a clearinghouse, exchange, prime broker, trading firm, or similar. - Proven expertise designing and implementing risk models at enterprise scale — production systems, not just research prototypes. - Deep experience modeling volatility, correlation, option skews, option pricing and implementing at scale for trad-fi derivatives, perpetuals, and fully collateralized event contracts. - Hands-on experience with market risk modeling, stress testing, and auto-liquidation mechanics in a clearing context. - Strong fluency with AI-assisted development and coding, paired with the judgment to pressure-test AI outputs against well-established risk models and catch what looks plausible but is wrong. - Expert-level Python (numerical stack: NumPy, pandas, SciPy; solid software engineering practices). - Advanced degree in a quantitative field (math, statistics, physics, financial engineering, CS) or equivalent experience. - Strong mathematical foundation in stochastic calculus and linear algebra. NICE TO HAVE - C# and/or C++ for performance-critical or production systems. - Familiarity with crypto market structure, perpetuals, or prediction markets. - Experience with CCP risk frameworks (CPMI-IOSCO PFMI, default management, margin methodology). - Experience building real-time risk systems. PAY TRANSPARENCY Base salary range: $400,000 to $450,000, plus equity and benefits. This is a good-faith range for the level we're hiring at. Experience varies widely within a title here, so if your expectations fall outside it, reach out anyway. We're always happy to talk it through. LOCATION & WORK SETUP This role is based in our New York City office, in person. You'll be working directly alongside the trading, engineering, and risk teams.
